Class InputEvent

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.events.InputEvent
Direct Known Subclasses:
BackspaceEvent, CharInputEvent, ConfirmEvent, NavigateDownEvent, NavigateLeftEvent, NavigateRightEvent, NavigateUpEvent, SelectEvent
public abstract class InputEvent extends Object
Abstract base for all keyboard input events produced by the TUI. Each subtype represents a distinct key or key category (arrow, enter, character, etc.) and is dispatched via InputEventVisitor to the current TUIScreen.
